format: Masked firm sheet (Stage E.32b). Keys of 'firms' are random firm labels (V-xxxx); 'pairs' keys are '<firm label>|<contract label>' with the contract labels of the contract sheet. Plan and stage names are replaced by neutral labels (plan P1, P2 ... within each firm; 'evaluation stage', 'funded stage'); 'modelled_plan' names the standard 50K plan the program models. Per firm: A_facts (automation and API rules, order-rate, minimum-hold and scalping rules, evaluation and funded stages), Rel_facts (operating age, payout delays, denials or disputes, rule changes, regulatory actions against the firm itself), R_facts_firm_wide, plan_facts and payout_context, each item with its date (E.28 lookup 2026-10-21, or the page fetch time of the 2026-10-28 refetch) and, for A and R facts, 'binds' (which plan and stages the rule binds, as its text states). 'lookup_date' gives the lookup date for the 12-months-before-lookup rule. Per pair: R_facts (news windows and product restrictions for that contract at that firm, trading-hour limits, the flat-by time) and whether the modelled plan lists it. Verified levels: full text (firm page) unless stated. The strategy profile being rated: a directional one-lot strategy run by an automated retail system, entering and exiting by market order (or a limit order priced under the trade-through rule), at most 20 round trips a trading day, holds from 5 minutes to the session close, latency of tens of milliseconds to one second, no co-location, no rebates.
